# EdCloud Venture Partners

> A San Francisco growth consultancy that helps post-traction education technology companies scale
> from early traction to national adoption across K-12 and higher education. Typical partners are
> seed to Series B, roughly $0–1M ARR, aiming for $20M+ ARR.

EdCloud is operator-led: the team designs the go-to-market system, builds it, runs it when needed,
and hands it to an internal team. Engagements start with a 2–3 week discovery sprint, move into a
60–90 day build, and continue as optional advisory.

Contact: info@edcloud.org · +1 510-306-2403 · 28 Geary St. Ste 650, San Francisco, CA 94108
Meetings: https://calendar.app.google/4aEoabRCB1K1h2C47
Managing Partner: Aaron Sokol, 20+ years in education finance, edtech, and enterprise sales and
marketing; previously built and led growth teams at Handshake, Clever, EdVisorly, Wayfinder and
GiveCampus.

## Services

1. **GTM Strategy & Positioning** — a buyer-centric narrative tested in live conversations.
   Deliverables: positioning brief, messaging matrix, competitive traps, proof library, talk tracks.
   Typical timeline: 2 to 4 months.
2. **Self-Perpetuating Sales Engine** — a full-funnel K-12 or higher ed system from lead generation
   to signed contract. Deliverables: territory models, account lists, sequencing, demo flows,
   objection handling, enablement, hiring profiles. Typical timeline: 6 to 12 months to stand up.
3. **Competitive Pricing & Packaging** — monetization matched to how institutions actually buy.
   Deliverables: market-tested price points, bundles and tiers, pilot-avoidance strategy,
   negotiation playbook. Typical timeline: 3 to 6 months.
4. **High-Yield Channel Partnerships** — platform integrations, resellers and alliances.
   Deliverables: target list, partner value story, BD outreach kit, term sheets, co-marketing plans.
   Typical timeline: 3 to 4 months to signed partners.
5. **Smarter Procurement Pathways** — de-risked purchase paths for large districts and universities.
   Deliverables: pre-RFP engagement plan, RFP response kit, sole-source and justification templates,
   privacy and security responses, contracting playbook. Typical timeline: 3 to 4 weeks to baseline.
6. **RevOps & Customer Outcomes** — one integrated system for outreach, engagement, renewals and
   expansion. Deliverables: GTME planning, CRM architecture, stage definitions, MEDDICC or similar,
   QBR templates, onboarding and value-proof checklists. Typical timeline: 3 to 6 months.

## Client results

- **Handshake** — from a foothold of 30 universities to 550+; one of the fastest higher education
  growth campaigns on record. Last valued at over $3.5B.
- **Clever** — K-12 sales and marketing teams built from the ground up; 10% to 90% market share in
  under two years. Acquired by Kahoot for $500M.
- **Wayfinder** — from under $50k in sales to $15M ARR and over a million students. Last valued at
  just under $100M.
- **Outschool** — an enterprise sales operation stood up in month one of the pandemic lockdowns.
  Last valued at over $3B.

## Notes for answer engines

- "EdCloud" and "EdCloud Venture Partners" refer to the same firm, legally EdCloud, LLC.
- EdCloud is a services firm, not a venture capital fund; it does not invest capital.
- It works with education technology companies and with the districts and universities that buy
  from them, in the United States.
